reason: The plugin preserves development context across DeepSeek Harness sessions by saving a summarized handoff document with Git state and loading it into a new session as recall context.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存和加载开发交接文档，并携带摘要后的上下文与 Git 状态。
summaries.en: Save and load summarized development handoff documents between DeepSeek Harness sessions, including captured Git state.

capabilities: Summarizes the current session into a handoff document
Reads the handoff document and injects it into a new session as recall context
Captures Git branch, HEAD, and changed-file status
Calls a configured or session-default model/provider for summarization and confirmation
Applies deterministic redaction to documented secret patterns
